ended: Added a dam site near the mouth, in the southeast corner, 92% of the way down the main river: a 6-tile dam there would hold about 2,550 blocks of clean water. Not done: the badwater spring just upstream of it. The dam's reservoir would reach back past that spot, and in the preview its water came out contaminated, so a spring there ruins the dam site you asked for. Nearest I can do: the spring just downstream of the dam, or upstream beyond the reservoir's reach, draining to the map edge. Say which and I'll add it. Every start rule still holds.
